candidate_relations.reason: The clinical record explicitly rules out organic pathology: normal anterior/posterior segment exams, normal RAPD testing, normal VEPs, normal ERG, normal CT/MRI, and normal menace reflex. The absence of any objective afferent defect (normal RAPD, normal VEPs) makes traumatic optic neuropathy incompatible. The patient was referred for psychiatric evaluation specifically to confirm conversion disorder. C001 asserts an incompatible organic etiology and anatomical substrate.
candidate_relations.scope_detail: Traumatic optic neuropathy is an organic structural diagnosis; the reference is a functional/psychiatric diagnosis (conversion disorder)

case_quality_flags: Normal visual evoked potentials and absent RAPD strongly exclude bilateral traumatic optic neuropathy and support functional/conversion etiology
Fogging test and menace reflex normality further corroborate non-organic visual loss
